headline: OAK @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 5.04 at LAA 3.39, with a projected total of 8.43. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: OAK moved +0.60 runs while LAA moved -1.06, changing the projected margin by +1.66 runs. The projected total fell -0.46, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +13.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Aaron Civale has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nick Kurtz, Shea Langeliers, Zach Neto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jo Adell, Tyler Soderstrom because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
